## Downstream Branch

Path: `docs/flow/branch.md`

This document is part of Project Home, section docs/flow.

# Downstream Branch

This document is reachable FROM the core (the overview links here) but it never
links back into the core: it only links onward to a [terminal](terminal.md)
page. That makes it a bow-tie OUT node (reachable from the core, cannot reach
it).

## Terminal Page

Path: `docs/flow/terminal.md`

This document is part of Project Home, section docs/flow.

# Terminal Page

This page has inbound links (from the downstream branch and the tendril aside)
but links to NOTHING onward: it is a genuine dead-end (in>0, out==0). It is also
reachable from the core via the branch, so it sits on the bow-tie OUT side.
